stock.description: China Longevity Group operates within the reinforced materials industry, engaging comprehensively in the design, development, production, and distribution of its specialized products. These offerings include advanced polymer-processed polyester fabric composite materials, diverse reinforced composites, conventional materials, and a range of inflatable and waterproof items. The company's versatile products find widespread application across numerous sectors, such as outdoor recreation, sports, renewable energy, protective equipment, construction, transportation, packaging, medical uses, safety solutions, advertising, and everyday consumer goods. Its commercial reach extends globally, with a notable presence in China, the USA, Russia, and various other international markets.
